comment: Claude Code versions the publish workflow builds — one image per entry, tagged <base-version>-cc<version>. The devc CLI reads this list to refuse a pin on an unlisted version. Policy: this list is a deliberate choice, not a moving window — each entry costs a full multi-arch CI build, so it holds the version the dogfood actually runs (`default`) plus whatever older pin still has users. Adding one = a line here + re-run the workflow; every entry MUST exist upstream (`npm view @anthropic-ai/claude-code versions`), a phantom fails one matrix branch silently until the run. Kept a list, not a scalar, so the matrix mechanism stays exercised.
